name: YOLO | You Only Live Twice
source:
"So, you received the opportunity of coming back to life. Sail on my boat, start over again and fix one of your major delusions back in time! Would you take the opportunity and rewrite your own history or conclude that errors lead you to your current self? Well, may be the luck with you."

- Lethe

[From:[url=https://banya.itch.io/yolo-you-only-live-twice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“所以，你得到了起死回生的机会。乘我的船航行，重新开始，及时纠正你的一个重大错觉！你会抓住这个机会改写自己的历史，还是得出结论，错误导致你变成了现在的自己？好吧，也许你很幸运。”

-忘川

[来自：[url=https://banya.itch.io/yolo-you-only-live-twice]itch.io[/url]]
